primary_sources.finding: The current page states the three main-transform families, the size rows, the 22-bit descriptor fields, the LFNST formula, and that inverse LFNST is followed by DCT2. It does not enumerate the complete legal tr_type_hor/tr_type_ver pairs when LFNST is off.
The updated attachment supplies the 16 LFNST matrices for nTrs 16/48, set indices 0..3 and lfnst_idx 1..2, plus the main-transform coefficient matrices and the 22-bit field map.
The standard is useful as reference semantics, but its two-dimensional fixed-point process depends on BitDepth and Log2TransformRange and therefore cannot silently replace the contest contract.

contract.nTrs_rule: 48 when width>=8 and height>=8, otherwise 16 for the listed official LFNST shapes
contract.lfnst_tr_set_idx_when_lfnst_idx_zero: not used for legality; preserve the complete 22-bit descriptor value

resolved_contracts.basis: The official contest requirement says inverse LFNST is followed by DCT2, while the interface exposes both horizontal and vertical transform types for the two-dimensional main transform. The official attachment enumerates every active set/index matrix.

remaining_root_blockers.description: For lfnst_idx=0, the official contest material lists shape support by transform family and exposes independent horizontal and vertical type fields, but does not state whether legal pairs are same-family only, a Cartesian product subject to per-axis size support, the five explicit MTS pairs, or another subset.
remaining_root_blockers.why_reference_is_insufficient: H.266/VTM pair rules require coding-context predicates absent from the contest descriptor and therefore remain reference_only.

remaining_root_blockers.description: The contest sources define coefficient matrices and one-dimensional dot products, and explicitly define LFNST rounding/clipping, but do not define the complete main-transform intermediate rounding, clipping/wrapping, accumulator width, or final 10-bit mapping for every case.
remaining_root_blockers.standard_cross_check: H.266 8.7.4.1 uses Clip3(CoeffMin,CoeffMax,(e+64)>>7) between two dimensions and a final shift dependent on BitDepth and Log2TransformRange. Those parameters are absent from it_info, and this differs from the frozen Step12B (+32)>>6, signed16 wrap, final low10 engineering baseline.
remaining_root_blockers.consequence: Neither the H.266 rule nor the Step12B baseline may be promoted to every contest case without an authoritative contest clarification.

downstream_dependency.description: A/B/C and LFNST arithmetic ownership are selected only after the final legal tuple universe and main-transform fixed-point contract are frozen.

clarification_required: For lfnst_idx=0, what complete tr_type_hor/tr_type_ver pairs are legal for each width and height?
For each main-transform stage and final 10-bit output, what exact rounding, shift, clipping/wrapping, accumulator-width and bit-selection rules define functional correctness?
decision: Keep Step12D-PRE STOP. Do not rerun matrix-dependent final evidence and do not authorize unified RTL until both root blockers are resolved.
